 Advertisement Slide playsets sold on Amazon and Walmart recalled due to serious injury risk
 Advertisement Updated: 1:38 PM CST Nov 8, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Valerie Zhang Anchor/Multi-Media Journalist Slide playsets sold on Amazon and Walmart recalled due to serious injury risk
 Updated: 1:38 PM CST Nov 8, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Valerie Zhang Anchor/Multi-Media Journalist More than 10,000 children's slide playsets sold on Walmart and Amazon are being recalled due to concerns that the openings in the equipment could trap a child's head or neck, posing a risk of serious injury or death, according to the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission. 
 The playsets are from the brand Arlopu with model numbers KT-CS17 and LY-31. 
 Advertisement They were sold online at Amazon.com and Walmart.com from April 2023 through August 2026 for between $90 and $130.
 The basketball nets on the recalled products can come unhooked from the rim, the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission added, creating hazards for entanglement and strangulation. 
 Consumers with the recalled products should stop using them and contact Arlopu for a free repair kit, which includes redesigned panels, basketball hoops and installation instructions. Consumers will be asked to provide a photo of the product showing the model number to arlopu_support@163.com. Once approved, the free repair kit will be mailed directly to the consumer.
